criteria.assertion: A capability decision is recorded: implemented/qualified or explicitly excluded.
criteria.scope_note: Both scoped tools implemented and qualified for finite macOS software behavior. Physical output and other platforms remain unqualified.

criteria.assertion: If implemented, every exposed subcommand/flag has a real execution route and no unsupported operation is presented as successful.
criteria.scope_note: Shared actual parser/command routes, all ten command forms, positive/negative contracts and finite CLI/VM/native execution verified. Option mapping is comprehensive; the test corpus is not every possible combination.

criteria.assertion: Compare visible form values, generated command/argv and actual request/output on synthetic inputs.
criteria.scope_note: Visible native form values, copied literal argv, actual outputs/requests and exact equivalent CLI controls passed on synthetic inputs. Final readable menu form captured; retained unchanged-service evidence is justified by the recorded identity/equivalence.

criteria.assertion: Qualify an actual packaged-app action before claiming GUI runtime parity.
criteria.scope_note: Actual signed, sandbox-entitled packaged Workshop actions covered all existing commands for this tool. Final menu-app action and source/artifact equivalence support reuse of unchanged execution/lifecycle evidence. No Print Center or VM substitution for native action.
